label.listening: Your companion is listening to you

pairing.title: Sync me with Saleads
pairing.qrLabel: Or scan me with your phone
pairing.qrAlt: QR code to sync this companion with Saleads
pairing.instruction: In Saleads, open «Meta Assistant», tap «Physical companion» and type this code.
pairing.expiresSoon: Changes in less than a minute

expired.title: That code expired
expired.body: I'm bringing you a new one. You don't need to do anything.

steps.knowledge: Receiving what Saleads knows about your business
steps.ready: Getting ready to talk with you

offline.title: I have no internet
offline.body: I need wifi to talk with Saleads. Please check:

checks.near: That I'm close to the router
checks.network: That the wifi is the usual one

live.greeting: Hi, {name}! How can I help you today?
live.greetingNoName: Hi! How can I help you today?
live.sample: Yesterday you made 12 sales on Instagram. Want me to show you which ad brought them?

intro.title: Your assistant, now by your side
intro.subtitle: Sync your physical companion and talk with your Meta Assistant without opening Saleads.

changes.knows: It knows {business}: your sales, your campaigns and your bets.
changes.talks: It listens and talks to you. It's the same assistant from Saleads and WhatsApp.
changes.control: Unpair it whenever you want, right here.

intro.needs: Your companion turned on, with wifi and showing a code on its screen.

connect.title: Type your companion's code
connect.subtitle: You'll see it on its screen, under «Sync me with Saleads».
connect.subtitleFromQr: We brought it from the QR you scanned. Check it matches its screen.
connect.hint: Lowercase is fine, and you can paste it with the dot.
connect.remaining: {count, plural, one {# character left} other {# characters left}}
connect.previewLabel: Look for it on its screen
connect.replaceNote: It replaces {device}, which will stop talking with you.

errors.invalidChar: Codes don't use 0, O, 1, I or L. Check your companion's screen.
errors.INVALID_CODE: That code doesn't match any companion. Check its screen and type it again.
errors.EXPIRED: That code expired. Your companion already shows a new one: type it here.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: You made several attempts in a row. Wait a minute and try again.

business.title: Which business should it know?
business.subtitle: Your companion learns from that business. If you want another one later, sync it again.

syncing.title: Your companion is learning about {business}
syncing.subtitle: It takes a few seconds. Watch its screen: it moves along with you.

steps.knowledge: Passing it what I know about {business}
steps.ready: Getting it ready to talk with you

syncing.background: You can close this window: syncing keeps going on its own.
syncing.slow: This is taking longer than usual. Check that your companion is still on and has wifi.

success.title: Your companion now knows {business}
success.subtitle: Talk to it whenever you want: it's the same Meta Assistant from Saleads and WhatsApp.
success.tryHelloTip: Get close and say «Hello». It will answer with your name.
success.helloSays: Hi! I'm ready to help you with {business}.

DEVICE_OFFLINE.title: Your companion has no internet
DEVICE_OFFLINE.body: Check that it's on and has wifi. The code works until it expires.

ALREADY_PAIRED.title: This companion is synced with another account
ALREADY_PAIRED.body: Ask that person to unpair it from their Meta Assistant. Then your companion will show you a new code.

NETWORK.title: We couldn't reach Saleads
NETWORK.body: Check your internet connection. Your code is still saved.

device.title: Your companion is synced
device.subtitle: It knows {business} and talks to you whenever you want.
device.name: Name
device.confirmBody: It stops talking with you and forgets what it knows about your business. To use it again, sync it with a new code.
device.unpairError: We couldn't unpair it. Check your connection and try again.
device.unpairedBody: It no longer speaks for your business. Whenever you want, sync it again with the code on its screen.

lab.title: Companion lab
lab.subtitle: Every state of the face, the robot screen and the sync flow in Saleads.
lab.demoBody: Open the robot screen in another tab and type here the code it shows.
